messages:
maya: Morning team — quick async standup. TL;DR: landed kernel hotpatch, added KV prefetch metrics, saw a p95 spike in microburst perf on node-3. Blocker: still trying to reproduce p95 in CI and isolate whether it's slot steal or KV thrash.
simon: Nice. Can you paste the exact perf command and where the logs are?
maya: Sure — command I used: `perf-bench --model llm-7b --seq 512 --batch 8 --prefetch on --runs 100`
logs snippet: `node-3 | p50=503ms p95=1120ms p99=1450ms` — full run saved at `/var/log/bench/7345.log`
kevin: That p95 looks like slot steal + queueing. Did you check slot occupancy + queue length during the run? Any steady-state CPU spikes?
maya: Slot occupancy jumped in short windows, CPU stayed ~70% but IO wait spiked. Also saw more KV evictions when prefixes had high variance.
nana: I'll run a targeted microburst with slot debug on dedicated-gpu-7 today and try reducing prefetch window to 32. Will post results.
simon: Quick config we can try for KV clamp: 
```
kv_cache:
  per_shard_limit: 1024
  ttl_seconds: 600
```
That should limit thrash. Thoughts?
kevin: Safe for most traffic but do canary at 5% first. Also add a metric for evictions/sec per-shard.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for `kv-cache-clamp` v2 -> 5% traffic (triggered at 7345678920)
maya: Thanks — I left a PR for the kernel prefetch guardrails: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4021. Needs a quick review, small perf change + unit test.
simon: @kevin can you take a look when you get a minute? If it's green we can bump canary to 20%.
kevin: On it, ETA today EOD.
perf-bot: perf-bot: benchmark queued: `microburst-512x8` on `dedicated-gpu-7`. Expected runtime ~30m.
nana: Minor blocker: lost access to shard-2 logs earlier, re-requested perms from infra. If I don't post results by 12:30 PT, that's why :)
maya: :thumbsup: I'll follow up on the infra ticket and try a local repro with a reduced prefetch window. Short-term mitigation idea: route hot prefixes to a warm-cache pool via policy `hot-route` to avoid evict storms. Low-risk canary.
simon: Action items summarized: maya -> follow infra ticket + try reduced prefetch; ana -> run microburst w/ slot debug & prefetch=32; kevin -> review PR + approve canary increase; simon -> add per-slot queue latency metric.
maya: If anyone finds a quick deterministic repro, paste logs here (preferably `--runs 1 --trace` output). Otherwise I'll post a bench gist tonight with the revised settings.
